outcome: Length of maternal and neonatal delivery hospitalization
cohort: Deaf women and a randomly selected comparison group of non-deaf women
finding: Deaf women were not at increased risk for most adverse pregnancy and neonatal outcomes compared to non-deaf women.
mod_finding: Deaf women who underwent vaginal delivery were more than twice as likely to have a delivery hospitalization of 4 or more days and had a modestly increased risk of cesarean delivery.
